default/30555.htm.text: Carrier Torocco: Ah! Why, hello. I am Carrier Torocco, a member of the Bronze Key Guild. Carriers are delivery experts, famous for fast and safe deliveries. But, I have made a big mistake this time... I've dishonored my guild... They will take my title away and expel me from the guild... Sob...

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30555-01..text: Carrier Torocco: Blast... What should I do? What should I do? How can I ever get that diamond back? I am in so much trouble... Gouph will kill me... What should I do? ... What the?! Who are you? How long have you been there? Did Gouph sent you?? Agghh... I'm sorry! Please forgive me...!!! I don't k…

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30555-03..text: Carrier Torocco: Have you found the Star Diamond...? Not yet... Oh no, oh no... What should I do... But you... Didn't you say that you would meet my friend, Miner Maron , and ask him about the jewel? Hurry up and go to the Strip Mine and meet Maron!

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30555-04..text: Carrier Torocco: This is...? Oh wow! The Treasure Chest I was delivering...! You've found the Star Diamond!!! Thank you. Thank you. How can I ever repay you... But first, please take this Treasure Chest to Collector Gouph ... He must be waiting...

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30555-05..text: Carrier Torocco: What should I do... What should I do... How can I ever get the diamond back... I am in so much trouble... Gouph will kill me... What should I do... What should I do... Disqualification and excommunication from the guild... ... Expensive fines that I can never pay back in this lifet…

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30555-01.ht.text: Carrier Torocco: Oh, right, a donation! Uh, well, hmm... I don't seem to have any money with me... Oh, my... Excuse me, aren't you the one who found the Star Diamond for me? Could I trouble you to help me again please? Could you possibly pay the donation for me?
